summary: Current project host-visible surfaces for ZOTERO-HOST-POLISH-WAVE-001. Surface smoke plus live geometry or explicit narrow-width degrade is authoritative before whole-window screenshots are treated as proof.

surfaces.summary: Open the cleanroom preference pane from Zotero preferences, prove structure smoke, and require at least one live control interaction when pane behavior or pref writeback changes.
smokeChecks: Host Action `preferences.openPane` opens the preferences window and selects the requested pane.
The target preference pane root is visible and the pane fragment is structurally observable after mounting.
The target preference pane exposes core controls, preference bindings, or load/localization bridge signals.
When a change touches preference pane control behavior, pref writeback, or theme mode, at least one live control interaction replays the real control and verifies writeback.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected preference pane.

surfaces.summary: Switch a library Item Pane sidenav button and verify that the selected pane becomes visible and ready.
smokeChecks: Host Action `itemPane.selectPane` can run in `ui-required` mode and replay the live Item Pane sidenav button action.
The target pane is visible in the Item Pane container after selection and its fragment is mounted.
The matching Item Pane sidenav button remains discoverable in the live host.
If a custom surface is edge-attached inside the Item Pane, it follows live pane bounds or explicitly degrades below a minimum viable width.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected Item Pane surface.

surfaces.summary: Open the right context pane and switch to the requested context pane section for the active reader tab; edge-attached layouts should follow the live pane bounds.
smokeChecks: Host Action `contextPane.setOpen` opens the right context pane.
The opened context pane exposes root or sidenav structure plus navigation/content signals.
Host Action `contextPane.selectPane` can run in `ui-required` mode and replay the live context pane button action before the target pane becomes visible.
If a custom surface uses edge-mode occupancy inside the context pane, it follows live pane bounds or explicitly degrades when the pane is too narrow.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the selected context pane surface.

surfaces.summary: Verify that the Reader renderToolbar injection becomes visible in a live reader instance and exposes a local evidence target.
smokeChecks: A live reader instance is opened through Host Action `reader.open`.
Host Action `reader.toolbar.triggerButton` replays a live renderToolbar button action in the reader.
The renderToolbar integration becomes visible in the reader toolbar and the post-action result is observable.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the toolbar surface.

surfaces.summary: Switch the active Reader sidebar view and verify that the requested sidebar surface is selected, ready, and geometry-aware when edge-attached.
smokeChecks: Host Action `reader.sidebar.selectView` can run in `ui-required` mode and replay the live sidebar button action.
The selected sidebar view is observed in the live reader state and on a real button or panel surface.
The active sidebar surface exposes structure or content signals instead of only a state-field match.
If a custom surface is attached to the sidebar edge, it follows live sidebar bounds or explicitly degrades below a minimum viable size.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the active reader sidebar view.

surfaces.summary: Show a live Zotero menu target, verify the registered menu item is visible, and trigger it through Host Actions.
smokeChecks: Host Action `menu.show` opens the live host menu for the requested target.
The registered menu item becomes visible and actionable in the live menu popup.
The popup exposes real menu structure or item content once opened.
Host Action `menu.trigger` replays the live menu action and a follow-up result becomes observable.
A surface-local evidence target is returned for the triggered menu item.
